details.cardSet: Combined Set "Worldreaver's Descent & Dominion of Darkness"
details.effect: Ward. On Evolve - Select up to 2 enemy followers on the field. They don't refresh during their controller's next start phase.

issues: The On Evolve ability encodes `skipRefreshNextStart` inside `targets`, but for `engage` it must be a top-level field on the effect. Change the ability to `{"timing":"onEvolve","effect":{"op":"engage","targets":{"type":"enemyFollower","count":2},"skipRefreshNextStart":true}}`.

details.effect: Spellchain (5) - This costs 1 less to play. ---------- Select up to 2 enemy followers on the field and deal them 2 damage. Put an Elements of Creation token into your EX area.

issues: The Spellchain (5) clause is a cost reduction, not a condition on whether the spell effect happens. Add a passive/play-cost-reduction ability such as a `playCostReduction` with `condition: {"type":"spellchain","count":5}` for amount 1, and keep the spell effect unconditional.

The damage effect should select up to 2 enemy followers and deal 2 damage to them; `dealDamage` with `count: 2` does not represent optional multi-target selection correctly. Encode the targeting as an effect that supports up to 2 selected followers, such as a split/multi-target damage form, rather than conditioning the whole spell.

details.cardSet: Booster Set #9 "Duet of Dawn and Dusk"
details.effect: Rush. [fanfare] Summon a Knight token. If there's a Queen Magnus the Black on your field, summon 2 instead. Strike - Put a Knight token into your EX area.

options.label: Summon 2 Knight tokens if there's a Queen Magnus the Black on your field

issues: Rush is correctly a keyword, but Strike should not be listed in `keywords`; it should only be represented by the `strike` ability already present. Remove `"strike"` from `keywords`.

The fanfare is not a choice. It should always summon 1 Knight token, and if Queen Magnus the Black is on your field, summon 2 instead. Replace the `choose` ability with a conditional effect such as `if namedFollowerOnFieldByName Queen Magnus the Black then summon 2 else summon 1`.

details.effect: [fanfare] Select an enemy follower on the field and deal it 4 damage. At the start of your end phase, if there are at least 3 other Vampire cards on your field, deal 3 damage to each enemy leader and give your leader [defense]+3.

issues: The end-phase condition should require at least 3 other Vampire cards on your field, but the parse uses `fieldTraitMin` count 3 without excluding this card. Encode the condition as requiring 4 Vampire cards including this one, or otherwise represent '3 other' correctly.

The end-phase damage effect should deal 3 damage to each enemy leader only, but `dealDamageAllEnemies` with `followersOnly: false` also hits enemy followers. Replace it with damage to enemy leaders only; if multiplayer support is intended, use an effect that targets each enemy leader rather than all enemies.
